title_as_printed: Experimental values of Ps/Pw, and calculated values of cp,s/cp,w and Cp,phi for NaCl solutions at 17.7 MPa

footnotes_as_printed.c: T is the initial temperature of the experiment. In all experiments DeltaT calculated from the power input, the heat capacity of water, and the heat losses (f) is (2.0+/-0.2) K.

pressure_note: flow calorimeter at 17.7 MPa (title); pressures read to +/-0.17 MPa

T.note: T is the initial (inlet) temperature of the experiment; the temperature rise in the cell is (2.0+/-0.2) K (footnote c)

value.what: apparent molar heat capacity of NaCl from cp,s/cp,w via eq (4) with cp,w of water at T and 17.7 MPa from Haar, Gallagher and Kell (listed in Table 1)

value2.what: ratio of specific (massic) heat capacity of solution to that of water at T and 17.7 MPa, eq (6) from Ps/Pw, the heat-loss factor f and the 298.15 K density ratio (water density from Fine and Millero, solution density from Chen, Emmet and Millero)

value3.what: measured heater power ratio, solution to water (primary measured quantity)

skip_rows.reason: temperature label rows (also carried by group_rows)

notes: Two side-by-side blocks per temperature (left: 0.0996, 0.2433, 0.4940 mol/kg; right: 1.0060, 3.0000 mol/kg) stacked left block first, then right. Footnote c is printed on the first temperature label (320.60 K) and applies to all; recorded as note T/K:c on that label row. Footnote letters a, b are on the column headers only.
